mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol induces hepatic metabolism and may increase propranolol clearance, while propranolol may inhibit estradiol metabolism via CYP3A4, potentially altering oral contraceptive efficacy and beta-blocker levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate control; consider alternative antihypertensive if propranolol levels become subtherapeutic; counsel on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy and backup contraception may be warranted.
